text:
Rina: Quick thread to follow up on the active/active reconciliation idea. I'm leaning toward a 'lease + intent log' model where writes are accepted only when a short-lived region lease exists, but we keep an append-only intent log replicated to other regions for debugging/reconcile.
Omar: Intent log seems useful for audits. How big would that log be for high-throughput tenants?
Rina: We keep only compacted deltas for non-regulated tenants, full intent history for regulated ones for 30 days. For heavy tenants we sample ops-traces.
Jules: Sampling is okay but we need deterministic reconciliation when conflict arises. We should record a monotonic commit-id with each write that's signed by the lease-holder. That way we can pick the highest-commit-id in reconciliation.
Priya: Signed commit-id + lease-holder signature sounds good. How do we protect KMS keys for signatures across regions? We can't export region keys for tenant-bound keys.
Omar: Option A: region-scoped signing keys, and a verification-only public key set distributed globally. Option B: cross-region HSM proxies (probably too complex). I vote Option A.
Rina: Agreed Option A. Verification keys are stored in control-plane vault and fetched by reconcilers.
Jules: About failover: avoid full cutover when a few shards lose lease. Suggest a shard-level backoff instead of tenant-wide swap. For write heavy tenants this reduces blast radius.
Priya: Shard-level sounds safer. But SDK-friendly contract? Mobile SDKs often don't know shard mapping. We need a clear failure code and a refresh hint header.
Omar: Use 409 with body `{"error":"lease_mismatch","retry_after":20}` and header `X-Refresh-Tenant: true`. SDKs should refresh mapping and retry within `retry_after`.
Rina: Good. Also propose a graceful degraded write mode: small local buffer on proxy for <5s to absorb transient control-plane hiccups, then flush or reject deterministically. This avoids tail latencies.
Jules: Buffering on proxy is okay if it's idempotent. Must attach idempotency keys. Also add a hard-bound of 5s to avoid residency violations.
Priya: Testing: simulate 1) lease churn under 10% packet loss, 2) split-brain where control-plane partitions for 45s, 3) reconcilers resolving two valid commit-ids. For each, we assert no PII escapes its resident region.
Omar: Prewarm note: when a shard becomes primary in new region, run `snapshot --fast-validate` then `tail-wal` until commit-age <2s. We should surface progress via `/api/ops/tenant/<id>/prewarm-status`.
Rina: UX: console shows per-tenant "commit-lag" and a clickable "force-prewarm" button that starts a dry-run first. Dry-run reports estimated bytes and time.
Jules: Reconciliation algorithm sketch: 1) gather signed commit-ids from both regions; 2) pick highest contiguous prefix; 3) for divergent suffix, if both write time overlap <window (configurable, default 30s) — mark as conflict and open reconcile ticket; else fast-apply higher commit-id.
Priya: For conflicts, we should have an automated safe-path for non-regulated tenants: apply last-wins with tombstone markers. Regulated tenants require ops approval.
Omar: Telemetry: emit `geo.commit_id` (tenant, shard, region) + `geo.commit_lag_ms`. Alert if commit_lag_ms > 2000 for >30s.
Rina: Security: ensure snapshots destined for prewarm are encrypted with a key that control-plane verifies is region-scoped for the target region before transfer. No unencrypted transit.
Jules: Implementation note: runtime must expose a small `LeaseClient` interface: `Acquire(tenant, shard) -> lease_meta`, `Renew -> ok/err`, `Release`. Keep lease renew inline in request flow and metrify failures.
Priya: Ops-runbook: when we see repeated 409+X-Refresh-Tenant from clients, run `inspect-lease --tenant` to see mismatches, then either `force-refresh-assert` or schedule quarantaine replay. Document the exact commands.
deploy-bot: Created ticket ARCH-3407 with checklist: spec LeaseClient, SDK retry contract, prewarm API, reconcile playbook.
Rina: Thanks — I'll put together a short RFC follow-up with the signed-commit proposal and the reconcile algorithm notes. Assigning owners: Jules -> reconciliation algo + runtime API, Omar -> KMS/keying & prewarm, Priya -> SDK/UX + alerts.
Omar: I'll prototype the signing workflow this sprint.
Jules: I'll start a PoC for the reconcile prefix algorithm and simulation harness.
Priya: I'll capture the SDK error mapping and add a migration plan for old mobile SDKs.
Rina: Cool. If nobody objects I'll post this summary to the main residency RFC thread and link ARCH-3407. Quick thumbs? :thumbsup:
Omar: +1
Jules: +1
Priya: +1
